### [component] Sheet (Different Directions)  [id: 25002]
by shadcnspace
A slide-out sheet (drawer) panel that can open from any edge — top, right, bottom, or left — with a header, form fields, and footer actions.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/user_38qAOtph5HovpSn2yjNYXjbTOm2/sheet-01/default/preview.1787762812125.webp

### [component] Drawer  [id: 31360]
by wensity
A mobile bottom sheet drawer with drag to dismiss, snap points and a drag handle, plus side drawers for larger screens. Ideal for mobile menus, filters and checkout steps.

install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/wensity/drawer?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 31360 })

### [component] Sheet with Scrollable Content  [id: 25010]
by shadcnspace
A side sheet (drawer) that opens from the right with a long, vertically scrollable body — ideal for terms & conditions, policies, or any lengthy content with header and footer actions.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/user_38qAOtph5HovpSn2yjNYXjbTOm2/sheet-02/default/preview.1787762237746.webp
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/shadcnspace/sheet-02?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 25010 })

### [component] Drawer  [id: 23558]
by ddoemonn
A drag-to-dismiss side panel that slides in from the left or right with a scrim, scroll lock, and focus trap, driven by a headless useDrawer hook.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/user_2y2pjLtk7oS33zts6BqhEIOHrAj/drawer/default/preview.1787587389547.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/ddoemonn/drawer?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 23558 })

### [component] Drawer  [id: 11442]
by coss.com
A panel that slides in from the edge of the screen with swipe gestures, snap points, and nested drawer support. Supports bottom, top, left, and right positions with default, inset, and straight variants.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/coss.com/drawer/nested-drawers/preview.1774285079281.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/coss.com/drawer?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 11442 })

### [component] Bottom Drawers  [id: 6034]
by ruixen.ui
This component is a set of bottom-sliding drawers, each triggered by a separate button and containing different content such as a newsletter signup, feedback form, or contact form. The layout keeps the content compact and centered, making it easy for users to focus on the inputs and actions without distractions. By stacking the buttons and organizing the drawers consistently, it provides a clean, user-friendly interface for quick interactions and data collection.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/ruixen.ui/bottom-drawers/default/preview.1756143367948.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/ruixen.ui/bottom-drawers?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 6034 })

### [component] Drawer Sides  [id: 30710]
by uiable
A set of drawer panels that slide in from any edge of the screen (top, right, bottom, or left), triggered by a button for each side.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/user_registry_uiable_1783486969177/drawer-sides/default/preview.1790339430088.webp
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/uiable/drawer-sides?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 30710 })

### [component] Keyboard Shortcuts Sheet  [id: 26146]
by cnippet-dev
A slide-out sheet panel that lists categorized keyboard shortcuts, each rendered with monospace key badges and section separators.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/user_36Tbt0v8JdD4jEycmBFhR8tojnR/v-sheet-14/default/preview.1789745474511.webp
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/cnippet-dev/v-sheet-14?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 26146 })

### [component] Quick Actions Grid Drawer  [id: 24848]
by cnippet-dev
A bottom drawer that reveals a 4-column grid of quick action buttons (edit, share, download, delete and more) with a destructive variant and a cancel footer.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/user_36Tbt0v8JdD4jEycmBFhR8tojnR/v-drawer-15/default/preview.1787745207824.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/cnippet-dev/v-drawer-15?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
